From this followed a new view of the curriculum: whoever teaches the new labour law course should know sociology, economics and psychology; it would be useful to have a few 'TAME' ECONOMISTS, SOCIOLOGISTS AND PSYCHOLOGISTS on the faculty. And Kennedy's characterisation, worth recalling: FOR THE SOCIAL, INTERDISCIPLINARITY MEANT THE LAW PROFESSOR AS A GENERALIST WHOSE ABILITIES ALLOW HIM TO MASTER ALL THE OTHER DISCIPLINES WITHOUT FORMAL TRAINING.

cards.q: How did the social resolve the question of the sources of law?
cards.a: In favour of THE LEGITIMACY OF JURISPRUDENCE, that is of JUDGE-MADE LAW — and it went further: ALL INTERPRETERS OF LAW (professors, administrative officials, lawyers drafting contracts, choosing litigation strategy and advising on liability) PARTICIPATE IN THE MAKING OF LAW. In the USA STARE DECISIS was discredited as THE ABUSE OF DEDUCTION PAR EXCELLENCE.

cards.q: What did interdisciplinarity mean for the social?
cards.a: THE LAW PROFESSOR AS A GENERALIST WHOSE ABILITIES ALLOW HIM TO MASTER ALL THE OTHER DISCIPLINES WITHOUT FORMAL TRAINING. The practical reason: only where judges, officials and lawyers understand not merely the RATIO but the TECHNIQUE of reform does reform work.

slides.title: The social claimed it was not about politics — and the liberals did not believe it
slides.text: The social jurists claimed that A MERE COMMITMENT TO SOCIAL JUSTICE IN THE IS-TO-OUGHT MODE DID NOT EXPOSE THEM TO THE DANGER OF ERODING THE DISTINCTION BETWEEN LAW AND POLITICS. They generally conceded the INTERNAL COHERENCE OF INDIVIDUALIST DEDUCTIVE LAW (stressing GAPS, not irremediable contradictions) and claimed THE SAME COHERENCE FOR SOCIAL LAW. THE SECOND CLAIM WAS STRONGLY CONTESTED: LIBERALS STUCK ON THE APPARATUS AND ASPIRATIONS OF CLT UNDERSTOOD THE SOCIAL AS CHAOTIC, WITHOUT A SINGLE COUNTER-PRINCIPLE TO SET AGAINST RIGHT AND WILL; AND THEY SAW THE VARIETY OF THE SOCIAL'S POLICIES AS A SYMPTOM OF THE TRAGIC POLITICISATION OF LAW FOLLOWING A PREMATURE ABANDONMENT OF LEGAL SCIENCE IN FAVOUR OF SOCIAL SCIENCE, NOT AS EVIDENCE OF THE SOCIAL'S SUPRA-POLITICAL TRUTH.

cards.q: How did the social defend the distinction between law and politics, and what did the liberals charge?
cards.a: It claimed that a commitment to social justice in the is-to-ought mode does not erode that distinction, and claimed THE SAME COHERENCE for social law as it conceded to individualist law. The liberals, however, understood the social as CHAOTIC, WITHOUT A SINGLE COUNTER-PRINCIPLE — and saw the variety of its policies as A SYMPTOM OF THE TRAGIC POLITICISATION OF LAW after a premature abandonment of legal science.

slides.title: How the social spread: old channels, new contents
slides.text: The second globalization followed the channels of the first. Students from all over Europe went to study law in FRANCE AND GERMANY; from the mid-19th century to the 1930s students from the rest of the world under Western influence poured into Europe; from the colonies to their 'metropoles' (Senegalese to Paris, Indonesians to Amsterdam). Where they had a choice, they went TO THE EUROPEAN METROPOLE WITH THE GREATEST PRESTIGE IN THEIR PART OF THE PERIPHERY — Latin Americans to Paris, Americans to Germany. FIRST GERMANY, LATER FRANCE were the sources of the social, but it developed in parallel in many places, AND ITS POLITICAL COLOUR VARIED FROM PLACE TO PLACE: IN ITALY it was at first MODERATELY LEFT, THEN FASCIST. IN SPAIN (FRANCO), PORTUGAL (SALAZAR) AND GREECE (METAXAS) IT WAS FASCIST; IN THE NETHERLANDS AND (FABIAN) BRITAIN MODERATELY LEFT. The American sociological jurists — POUND, CARDOZO, BRANDEIS — produced a version first moderately left and then moderately right; they drew on the French and the Germans, but were strongly influenced by HOLMES, WHO DEVELOPED A DISTINCTIVELY AMERICAN VARIANT OF THE 'ABUSE OF DEDUCTION' THESIS BEFORE GENY.

cards.q: What political colour did the social have in individual countries?
cards.a: In ITALY at first MODERATELY LEFT, then FASCIST. In SPAIN (Franco), PORTUGAL (Salazar) and GREECE (Metaxas) FASCIST. In the NETHERLANDS and Fabian BRITAIN MODERATELY LEFT. In the USA (Pound, Cardozo, Brandeis) first moderately left and then moderately right.

cards.q: What role did Holmes play in the American version of the social?
cards.a: HE DEVELOPED A DISTINCTIVELY AMERICAN VARIANT OF THE 'ABUSE OF DEDUCTION' THESIS BEFORE GENY and strongly influenced Pound, Cardozo and Brandeis, who otherwise drew on the French and the Germans.

slides.title: Nationalism in three modes
slides.text: As the social settled in the West, students from eastern Europe, Latin America, southern, eastern and south-eastern Asia, the Arab world and Africa appropriated it and took it home. NATIONALISM WAS A KEY DIMENSION OF THE DIFFUSION, BUT IN AT LEAST THREE MODES, NOT AS A SINGLE PHENOMENON. (1) NATIONALISM AS IRREDENTISM AND A DRIVING FORCE OF ETHNIC PURITY — which the progressive European social people regarded, along with class conflict, as a scourge capable of destroying European civilisation. The theorists of the social therefore undertook A PROFOUND RETHINKING OF PUBLIC INTERNATIONAL LAW in an attempt to contain and shape nationalism as A LIFE-GIVING AND LIFE-DESTROYING IRRATIONAL FORCE. The result: THE MANDATE SYSTEM, THE SHIFT TO INSTITUTIONS (THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS), BRICOLAGE INSTITUTIONS SUCH AS THE FREE CITY OF DANZIG, THE INTERWAR MINORITY PROTECTION REGIMES AND A SELF-CONSCIOUS REJECTION OF THE 'LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY'. They inspired and were inspired by innovations in labour law: 'INDUSTRIAL WAR' CONTAINED BY ANALOGY WITH 'REAL' WAR, THE DEFECTS OF THE LOGIC OF PROPERTY PARALLELING THOSE OF THE LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY. (2) At the same time the social was A KEY SLOGAN OF NATIONALISM ITSELF, in its fascist and authoritarian right-wing forms in many parts of the world, including the new states carved out of the Ottoman and Austro-Hungarian empires and countries such as ARGENTINA (PERÓN) AND BRAZIL (VARGAS). And from this follows a fact that sounds shocking but is exactly what Kennedy claims: IN THE INTERWAR PERIOD, PROGRESSIVE OR REVOLUTIONARY LEFT-WING REFORMERS IN COUNTRIES SUCH AS COLOMBIA AND MEXICO AND THEIR RIGHT-WING ENEMIES USED VIRTUALLY IDENTICAL SOCIAL, CORPORATIST, ANTI-CAPITALIST AND ANTI-LIBERAL RHETORIC. THE MEXICAN FEDERAL LABOUR LAWS OF THE 1930s, THE CELEBRATED ACHIEVEMENT OF THE MEXICAN LEFT'S REVIVAL UNDER CÁRDENAS, CLOSELY RESEMBLED MUSSOLINI'S CARTA DI LAVORO, IF THEY WERE NOT DIRECTLY MODELLED ON IT. (3) IN THE COLONIES nationalism meant NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE and was A CALL TO ARMS OF THE PEOPLE AS A WHOLE AGAINST THE COLONIAL MASTER. The colonial powers recruited natives into the lower reaches of the administrations; elements of pre-colonial elites survived and sought success in the new order through European education. Some found French, British, Dutch and American ACADEMIC MENTOR-ALLIES who helped them TURN PROGRESSIVE METROPOLITAN SOCIAL IDEOLOGY INTO AN ARGUMENT FOR EVERYTHING FROM 'NATIVE WELFARE' TO NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE (FURNIVALL, the Dutch sociologists of adat law, LAMBERT, TUGWELL).

cards.q: How did the social theorists rethink international law because of nationalism, and what came of it?
cards.a: They understood nationalism as A LIFE-GIVING AND LIFE-DESTROYING IRRATIONAL FORCE to be contained and shaped. The result: THE MANDATE SYSTEM, the shift to institutions (THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS), bricolage institutions such as THE FREE CITY OF DANZIG, THE INTERWAR MINORITY PROTECTION REGIMES and A SELF-CONSCIOUS REJECTION OF THE 'LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY'.

cards.q: What does the comparison of the Mexican labour laws of the 1930s with the Carta di Lavoro demonstrate?
cards.a: That in the interwar period PROGRESSIVE LEFT-WING REFORMERS AND THEIR RIGHT-WING ENEMIES USED VIRTUALLY IDENTICAL SOCIAL, CORPORATIST, ANTI-CAPITALIST AND ANTI-LIBERAL RHETORIC. The Mexican federal labour laws, the celebrated achievement of the left under CÁRDENAS, closely resembled MUSSOLINI'S CARTA DI LAVORO, if they were not directly modelled on it.

cards.q: How did the social operate in the colonies?
cards.a: Nationalism there meant NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE and a call to arms against the colonial master. Native elites educated in Europe found ACADEMIC MENTOR-ALLIES (Furnivall, the Dutch sociologists of adat law, Lambert, Tugwell) who helped them TURN PROGRESSIVE METROPOLITAN SOCIAL IDEOLOGY INTO AN ARGUMENT FOR EVERYTHING FROM 'NATIVE WELFARE' TO NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE.

slides.title: Every nation discovered the same thing — a catalogue of national appropriations
slides.text: The pattern Shalakany demonstrated for the Egyptian case repeats itself: CASE AFTER CASE, THE IMPORTING ELITE FOUND IN THE NATIONAL CULTURE SOMETHING THAT MADE THE SOCIAL — AS AGAINST THE FORMALIST INDIVIDUALISM ATTRIBUTED TO CLT — UNIQUELY APPROPRIATE FOR THAT PARTICULAR NATION. THE CATHOLIC SOUTH OF EUROPE (Portugal, Spain, Italy, Hungary): the social is the philosophy of THE CHURCH as stated in RERUM NOVARUM (1897) — 'of new things', that is industrialisation, urbanisation, interdependence; in the 1930s the Vatican made its inglorious accommodation with fascism, immortalised in the social rhetoric of QUADRAGESIMO ANNO. THE PROTESTANT NORTH: the Dutch interpreted the social as particularly appropriate to THE INTERDEPENDENT CULTURE OF DYKE-BUILDING AND LAND RECLAMATION. RUSSIA: the celebrated VILLAGE COMMUNE, THE MIR. THE USA: ROSCOE POUND in a remarkable essay in the Harvard Law Review of JANUARY 1917 LAID THE ILLS OF MODERN AMERICAN SOCIETY AT THE DOOR OF THE 'ROMANISATION' OF AMERICAN LAW in the second half of the 19th century; he presented CLT as an 'ALIEN' mode of legal thought whose formalist individualism had displaced the 'ORGANIC' COMMON LAW MODE BASED ON THE CONCEPT OF 'RELATION' (husband and wife, master and servant, landlord and tenant) — the rediscovery of the medieval common law tradition was to be the basis for bringing American law into accord with the conditions of social interdependence. THERE WERE PRECIOUS FEW CITATIONS OF THE GERMAN AND FRENCH CIVILIAN ORIGINATORS OF THE PROGRAMME. LATIN AMERICA: right-wing authoritarians invoked HISPANIDAD, whose social essence was Catholic yet uniquely American. MEXICO: land reform and the EJIDO system (state-regulated and subsidised cooperative peasant agriculture) was said to be a return to PRE-COLUMBIAN MODES OF SOCIAL ORGANISATION. EGYPT: SANHURI'S eclectic, socially oriented civil code, later adopted or adapted in many other Arab countries, was INDIGENOUS AND EMINENTLY TRADITIONAL AND AT THE SAME TIME ULTRA-MODERN, BECAUSE ISLAMIC LAW WAS AND ALWAYS HAD BEEN SOCIAL. AFRICA: SENGHOR'S NÉGRITUDE, KENYATTA'S 'AFRICAN IDEA OF PROPERTY', NYERERE'S AFRICAN SOCIALISM UJAMAA. CHINA: SUN YAT-SEN and then CHIANG KAI-SHEK developed the nationalist ideology of the KUOMINTANG, the main opponent of Chinese communism, as a complex mixture of CONFUCIAN 'SOCIAL' AND LIBERAL ELEMENTS — AFTER THE SECOND WORLD WAR CHIANG HIRED ROSCOE POUND AS A LEGAL ADVISER in building the legal regime of the Republic of China on Taiwan. And the social as a public law ideology of DISEMPOWERED SUBGROUPS within the British colonial structure: the QUEBECOIS in Canada, the AFRIKANERS in South Africa — there the civilian private law retained THE FORMALISM OF THE MINORITY'S METROPOLE AS A SYMBOL OF RESISTANCE to the common law of the colonial power. PALESTINE: jurists influenced by Savigny and Ehrlich developed a secular 'HEBREW LAW' which was to be first individualist and then social, AND THEN WENT OUT OF FASHION AT PRECISELY THE MOMENT WHEN THE STATE OF ISRAEL BEGAN TO DEVELOP A HIGHLY SOCIAL PUBLIC LAW REGIME.

cards.q: How did Roscoe Pound appropriate the social for America in 1917?
cards.a: In an essay in the Harvard Law Review he laid the ills of modern American society AT THE DOOR OF THE 'ROMANISATION' OF AMERICAN LAW in the second half of the 19th century: he presented CLT as an 'ALIEN' MODE whose formalist individualism had displaced the 'ORGANIC' COMMON LAW MODE BASED ON THE CONCEPT OF 'RELATION'. THERE WERE PRECIOUS FEW CITATIONS OF THE GERMAN AND FRENCH ORIGINATORS.

cards.q: Name at least five national appropriations of the social.
cards.a: THE CATHOLIC SOUTH: the philosophy of the Church in RERUM NOVARUM (1897). THE NETHERLANDS: the culture of DYKE-BUILDING AND LAND RECLAMATION. RUSSIA: the village commune, the MIR. MEXICO: the EJIDO system as a return to PRE-COLUMBIAN modes. EGYPT: Sanhuri's code, because ISLAMIC LAW ALWAYS HAD BEEN SOCIAL. AFRICA: Senghor's NÉGRITUDE, Kenyatta's 'African idea of property', Nyerere's UJAMAA. CHINA: the Confucian 'social' in Kuomintang ideology.

cards.q: Why did Afrikaner and Quebecois private law retain its formalism?
cards.a: Because THE CIVILIAN PRIVATE LAW OF THE MINORITY'S METROPOLE FUNCTIONED AS A SYMBOL OF RESISTANCE to THE COMMON LAW OF THE COLONIAL POWER. The social there served instead as the public law ideology of a disempowered subgroup within the British colonial structure.

slides.title: Why every nation discovered the same thing — the invented-communities hypothesis
slides.text: Savigny's formalist derivation of the whole of private law from right and will gave way to Savigny's insistence that national legal orders REPRESENT AND OUGHT TO REPRESENT THE PARTICULAR NORMATIVE ORDER OF THE PEOPLE IN QUESTION. BUT THE QUESTION REMAINS WHY, AT THE MOMENT OF DISCOVERING NATIONAL PARTICULARITY, EVERY NATION DISCOVERED THE SAME THING. Kennedy's easy but initially plausible explanation: THE SOCIAL WAS AN INSTRUMENT OF ELITES FACING PRECISELY THE ABSENCE OF THE SOCIAL — elites charged with administering territories TORN BY CLASS CONFLICT or containing WILDLY HETEROGENEOUS TRIBAL, CULTURAL, RACIAL AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS, first assembled as colonies according to the interests of empires and great powers and then, at national independence, re-parcelled according to the interests of great powers and local elites. THE IDEOLOGY OF THE SOCIAL WAS (perhaps) NOT A REFLECTION OF NATIONAL PARTICULARITY BUT AN INSTRUMENT IN THE 'INVENTION' OF AS YET NON-EXISTENT NATIONAL COMMUNITIES (HOBSBAWM, ANDERSON). This hypothesis is, on Kennedy's view, supported by the story of gender in the social.

cards.q: Why, on Kennedy's account, did every nation 'discover' the same thing in the social?
cards.a: Because THE SOCIAL WAS AN INSTRUMENT OF ELITES FACING PRECISELY THE ABSENCE OF THE SOCIAL — territories torn by class conflict or wildly heterogeneous in tribe, culture, race and religion. THE IDEOLOGY OF THE SOCIAL WAS NOT A REFLECTION OF NATIONAL PARTICULARITY BUT AN INSTRUMENT IN THE 'INVENTION' OF AS YET NON-EXISTENT NATIONAL COMMUNITIES (Hobsbawm, Anderson).

slides.title: Sex and the family: the dramatic ambiguity of the social
slides.text: The idea of 'the social' was DRAMATICALLY AMBIGUOUS when applied to family and sexual relations. The social demanded that employers treat workers, and merchants treat consumers, according to A SOCIAL ETHIC, and the rhetoric was SOLIDARITY AND COMMUNITY. The construction of the relations of family members as inherently ALTRUISTIC AND PROTECTIVE was an obvious reference and support for the demands of workers and consumers. In one sense it was a matter of REVERSING THE 19TH-CENTURY DISSOLUTION OF THE HOUSEHOLD AND REIMPOSING ON THE CAPITALIST THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH, THIS TIME WITH STATE ENFORCEMENT OF SOLIDARITY INSTEAD OF TOLERANCE OF DISCRETION. The enemies of the social tirelessly pointed out that this was a 'REGRESSION' FROM CONTRACT TO STATUS and that it was 'degrading' to treat beneficiaries as though, like members of a Roman or feudal household, they lacked legal capacity. AT THE SAME TIME, HOWEVER, THE SOCIAL MEANT MODERNITY. The progressive social approach to sex and the family in the North Atlantic was markedly SECULAR, influenced by THE FIRST WAVE OF WESTERN FEMINISM, and itself influenced the most secular and most Western segments of the peripheral elites. Its programme: TO RELAX MANY OF THE PROHIBITIONS OF THE 19TH-CENTURY GENDER REGIME AND AT THE SAME TIME TO INCREASE THE INTRUSIVE ENFORCEMENT OF THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH THAT CLT HAD REGARDED AS MERELY MORAL, NOT LEGAL. Social ideology treated the family as AN INSTITUTION WITH FUNCTIONS AND PURPOSES ESSENTIAL TO THE SOCIAL WHOLE — the family was neither a matter of purely private concern nor an area quarantined as moral rather than legal.

cards.q: In what way was the social ambiguous when applied to the family?
cards.a: On one side it wanted to REVERSE THE 19TH-CENTURY DISSOLUTION OF THE HOUSEHOLD AND REIMPOSE ON THE CAPITALIST THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH (with state enforcement of solidarity instead of tolerance of discretion) — which its enemies called a 'REGRESSION FROM CONTRACT TO STATUS'. On the other side IT MEANT MODERNITY: it was secular and influenced by the first wave of feminism.

cards.q: What was the progressive social programme for the family, in one sentence?
cards.a: TO RELAX MANY OF THE PROHIBITIONS OF THE 19TH-CENTURY GENDER REGIME AND AT THE SAME TIME TO INCREASE THE INTRUSIVE ENFORCEMENT OF THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH THAT CLT HAD REGARDED AS MERELY MORAL, NOT LEGAL. The family became AN INSTITUTION with functions essential to the social whole — not a matter of purely private concern.

slides.title: The progressive and the authoritarian programme for sex and the family
slides.text: The 'STUDY' was the key instrument here too, just as with industrial accidents: exposing the bad conditions of poor families mobilizes middle-class sympathy in favour of regulation. Studies could also support DECRIMINALIZATION AND DESTIGMATIZATION by showing that OBSOLETE MORALISTIC CONTROLS OF SEXUALITY ARE SOCIALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. Public-health arguments covered everything from infant nutrition to the spread of venereal disease by prostitutes driven into vice by a combination of POVERTY AND REPRESSIVE SOCIAL NORMS (a 'ruined' woman could not marry). The new science of SEXOLOGY proposed reform in the interest of adult sexual enjoyment, BUT ALSO THE STABILIZATION OF TRADITIONAL GENDER ARRANGEMENTS IN THE INTEREST OF SOCIETY AS A WHOLE. IN THE PROGRESSIVE VERSION the prohibitions on non-marital sex were to be relaxed: DECRIMINALIZATION OF FEMALE ADULTERY AND OF SEX BETWEEN UNMARRIED PEOPLE, DIVORCE BY MUTUAL CONSENT, LEGALIZATION OF THE SALE OF CONTRACEPTIVES, DESTIGMATIZATION OF ILLEGITIMACY, LEGALIZATION OF ABORTION (so that it would be performed under medical supervision). Decriminalization of PROSTITUTION went hand in hand with its REGULATION IN BROTHELS, typically in the social mode of an inspectorate with criminal sanctions and command powers. And the important qualification you must not leave out in the exam: SOCIAL IDEOLOGY TENDED TO PATHOLOGIZE AND MEDICALIZE HOMOSEXUALITY. Duties that were to be INCREASED: control of DOMESTIC VIOLENCE against wives and children, again by setting up administrative agencies with low-level criminal sanctions and the power to initiate transfers of child custody. Family and juvenile courts and the newly created profession of 'SOCIAL WORK' aimed at a DEFORMALIZED, WELFARE-ORIENTED RATHER THAN RIGHTS-ORIENTED LEGAL REGIME (the best interest of the child, rehabilitation instead of punishment). The main opponents of the progressives were the CATHOLIC CHURCH AND SOCIALLY CONSERVATIVE PROTESTANT SECTS (the Bible Belt in the USA, Anglicanism in Britain). As in the 19th century the agenda was transnational and the arguments similar everywhere, BUT THERE WAS NOTHING LIKE A GLOBALIZATION OF ONE PARTICULAR SOCIAL LEGAL REGIME: outcomes differed from country to country and from decade to decade according to the local balance of forces. THE SOCIAL PROVIDED, LIKE CLT, A SCHEME OF CATEGORIES, ARGUMENTS AND ELEMENTS FOR LEGISLATION — A LANGUE OUT OF WHICH NATIONAL SPEAKERS MANUFACTURED THE PAROLE OF POSITIVE LAW.

cards.q: What did the progressive social programme for sexuality contain?
cards.a: DECRIMINALIZATION OF FEMALE ADULTERY AND OF SEX BETWEEN UNMARRIED PEOPLE, DIVORCE BY MUTUAL CONSENT, LEGALIZATION OF THE SALE OF CONTRACEPTIVES, DESTIGMATIZATION OF ILLEGITIMACY, LEGALIZATION OF ABORTION and DECRIMINALIZATION OF PROSTITUTION coupled with its REGULATION IN BROTHELS. BUT: SOCIAL IDEOLOGY TENDED TO PATHOLOGIZE AND MEDICALIZE HOMOSEXUALITY.

cards.q: What kind of legal regime were family courts and social work aiming at?
cards.a: A DEFORMALIZED, WELFARE-ORIENTED RATHER THAN RIGHTS-ORIENTED LEGAL REGIME — the best interest of the child, rehabilitation instead of punishment. The duties to be INCREASED were mainly the control of DOMESTIC VIOLENCE, again through administrative agencies with low-level sanctions.

slides.title: The authoritarian social: the family as the soul of the nation
slides.text: THE AUTHORITARIAN NATIONALIST APPROACH was very different but NO LESS 'SOCIAL'. In Nazi Germany — and according to Kennedy only there — it was relentlessly 'MODERN', EUGENIC about reproduction as well as racial extermination. Authoritarians elsewhere were openly allied with the CATHOLIC OR GREEK ORTHODOX CHURCH (peripheral Europe and Latin America) or with CONFUCIAN OR SHINTO 'FAMILY VALUES' in East Asia. And here is the twist to remember: THE FAMILY PLAYED THE ROLE OF THE 'HEART' OR 'SOUL' OF THE NATION PRECISELY BECAUSE IT WAS TRADITIONAL, NOT MODERN. The whole nation was, for example, a family, and the authoritarian leader was the 'FATHER'. The interests of the nation required the reform of the family in the interest of society, as in the progressive agenda, BUT THE RHETORIC WAS PROTECTION, NOT LIBERTY AND EQUALITY. The family agenda: SUBSIDIZE THE TRADITIONAL NUCLEAR FAMILY AND THE ENTERPRISE OF CHILD-REARING SO THAT THE NATION WOULD BE STRENGTHENED AGAINST ITS ENEMIES — REINFORCING THE POWER OF FATHERS WHILE INCREASING SERVICES TO MOTHERS CONFINED TO THE HOME, PRONATALISM, and MAINTAINING THE SYSTEM OF PROHIBITIONS OF EXTRA-MARITAL FEMALE SEXUALITY. The main threats to the authoritarian social: 'GODLESS COMMUNISM' and the 'DECADENT' LIBERALIZING TREND IN BOURGEOIS HUMANISM AND SOCIALISM. HOMOPHOBIA AND ANTI-SEMITISM WENT HAND IN HAND.

cards.q: Why did the family play the role of the 'soul of the nation' in the authoritarian social?
cards.a: PRECISELY BECAUSE IT WAS TRADITIONAL, NOT MODERN. The whole nation was, for example, a family and the authoritarian leader was the 'FATHER'. They demanded reform of the family in the interest of society just as the progressives did, BUT THE RHETORIC WAS PROTECTION, NOT LIBERTY AND EQUALITY.

cards.q: What did the authoritarian family agenda look like?
cards.a: SUBSIDIZE THE TRADITIONAL NUCLEAR FAMILY AND CHILD-REARING so that the nation would be strengthened against its enemies: REINFORCING THE POWER OF FATHERS WHILE INCREASING SERVICES TO MOTHERS CONFINED TO THE HOME, PRONATALISM and MAINTAINING THE PROHIBITIONS OF EXTRA-MARITAL FEMALE SEXUALITY. The threats were 'GODLESS COMMUNISM' and the 'DECADENT' liberalizing trend; HOMOPHOBIA AND ANTI-SEMITISM WENT HAND IN HAND.

slides.title: The third configuration: colonial nationalism and the family
slides.text: NATIONAL LIBERATION PARTIES in the colonized world faced a THIRD CONFIGURATION. Nationalists were everywhere contested in their claim to lead the resistance; often more important than communist parties were the political formations representing the fragments that the nationalists hoped to weld into a coalition: ISLAMIC REFORM PARTIES (and Hindu parties in India), TRIBAL POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS (in all regions, not just Africa) and RACIALLY ORGANIZED GROUPS, often in reaction against local minorities (against the Chinese or Indians in Southeast Asia and the Pacific, against Arabs in sub-Saharan Africa) who had arrived and prospered under colonial auspices. THE NATIONALIST PROJECT WAS TO DEVELOP A NOTION OF NATIONAL PARTICULARITY AS A SECULAR FORCE, AGAINST BOTH THE COLONIAL POWER AND THE FRAGMENTING ELEMENTS OF THE LOCAL SITUATION. And the family played a large role here: THE NATION COULD UNITE AROUND ITS UNIQUE FAMILY VALUES, SOCIAL VALUES THAT PROVIDED A CLEAR POINT OF CONTRAST WITH THE IMAGINED SEXUAL AND FAMILIAL DEGENERACY OF THE METROPOLE AND OF THE 'WEST' IN GENERAL (CHATTERJEE). This permitted a complex set of COMPROMISES: (1) in the name of modernity, nationalists could support the EDUCATION AND EMPLOYMENT OF WOMEN under the regulated conditions the social programme was introducing for all workers; (2) women were, ideally through state-sponsored organizations, TO PARTICIPATE IN THE NATIONAL STRUGGLES AS ONE OF THE SOCIAL GROUPS alongside labour, peasants, youth and intellectuals, making up the corporatist party of the national liberation coalition. AT THE SAME TIME, however, in regulating gender roles in marriage and extra-marital sexuality the nationalists could STRIKE A COMPROMISE WITH LOCAL FORCES OF TRADITION: SOCIAL RIGHTS FOR LABOUR, LAND REFORM AND INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT COULD NOT ONLY COEXIST BUT HARMONIZE WITH IMMOBILITY IN FORMAL INEQUALITY UNDER ISLAMIC LAW, WITH TOLERATION OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AND HONOUR CRIMES AND WITH THE CELEBRATION OF FEMALE VIRGINITY BEFORE MARRIAGE. Women's rights activists ran into the problem that MODERNIZING SECULAR MALE ELITES CHOSE TO SPLIT THE DIFFERENCE ON QUESTIONS OF SEX AND THE FAMILY WITH THE CONSERVATIVE ULEMA IN THE MUSLIM WORLD OR WITH THE PRIESTS IN THE CATHOLIC ONE (ABU-ODEH). THE SAVIGNYAN COMPROMISE THUS TOOK A NEW TURN: PROGRESSIVE VIEWS ON LABOUR, CONSUMER AND HOUSING LAW WERE SOMETIMES COMBINED WITH FASCIST OR TRADITIONALIST VIEWS ON FAMILY LAW AND ON THE POSITION OF WOMEN GENERALLY — WHEREAS IN THE 19TH-CENTURY CODES IT WAS ECONOMIC LIBERALISM THAT WAS COMBINED WITH CONSERVATISM IN FAMILY LAW.

cards.q: What role did the family play in the colonial nationalist project?
cards.a: The nation could UNITE AROUND ITS UNIQUE FAMILY VALUES, which provided a CLEAR POINT OF CONTRAST WITH THE IMAGINED SEXUAL AND FAMILIAL DEGENERACY OF THE METROPOLE AND THE 'WEST' (Chatterjee) — against the colonial power and against the fragmenting tribal, religious and racial elements alike.

cards.q: How was the Savignyan compromise reversed in the 20th century?
cards.a: IN THE 19TH-CENTURY CODES, ECONOMIC LIBERALISM was combined with CONSERVATISM IN FAMILY LAW. In the 20th century, by contrast, PROGRESSIVE VIEWS ON LABOUR, CONSUMER AND HOUSING LAW WERE COMBINED WITH FASCIST OR TRADITIONALIST VIEWS ON FAMILY LAW AND THE POSITION OF WOMEN.

cards.q: What problem did women's rights activists run into in postcolonial states?
cards.a: That MODERNIZING SECULAR MALE ELITES CHOSE TO 'SPLIT THE DIFFERENCE' ON QUESTIONS OF SEX AND THE FAMILY WITH THE CONSERVATIVE ULEMA in the Muslim world or with the PRIESTS in the Catholic one (Abu-Odeh) — social rights for labour and land reform could HARMONIZE with formal inequality, toleration of domestic violence and honour crimes.

slides.title: The social state, land regimes and ISI
slides.text: THE SOCIAL STATE figures strongly in the social and political history of the period, BUT IT WOULD BE A MISTAKE TO TREAT IT AS THE 'ESSENCE' or, from the point of view of law, as the central development. The most important legal notions: SOCIAL INSURANCE (unemployment, accidents, health, old-age pensions) and NEED-BASED ENTITLEMENTS, conceived as REHABILITATIVE, with an administration performing an assessment of need and delivering services meant to REINTEGRATE THE RECIPIENT INTO THE SUPPOSEDLY NORMAL UNIVERSE OF THE LABOUR MARKET. Typical manifestations with BISMARCKIAN GERMAN ORIGINS, adopted across the capitalist West. An easy transition to the notion of SOCIAL RIGHTS understood as a 'THIRD GENERATION' (after private law and political rights), in a position of juristic ambiguity typical of the period: SOCIAL RIGHTS WERE LEGAL, EVEN CONSTITUTIONAL — FIRST IN MEXICO IN 1917 — BUT NOT JUSTICIABLE AS TO THE LEVEL OF BENEFITS PROVIDED, although justiciable as entitlements once established by statute. The social state could globalize only to a limited extent, because it presupposed a certain kind of development, a degree of political autonomy and a political configuration: A SIGNIFICANT DEGREE OF REDISTRIBUTION FROM THE MIDDLE TO THE LOWER MIDDLE AND WORKING CLASSES AND A SIGNIFICANT DEGREE OF PATERNALIST CONTROL OVER THOSE CLASSES' SPENDING DECISIONS (forcing them to insure themselves). This had to be accepted, for the protection of the social whole, either by an ELECTORAL MAJORITY (the New Deal in the USA, the Front Populaire in France, the corporatist social democracy of Austria) OR BY AN AUTHORITARIAN ELITE (Germany, Argentina). LAND REGIMES: social jurists were deeply interested in the agricultural workers of the South, precisely those whom CLT had crammed into LOCATIO OPERARUM, a regime of freedom of contract, blithely ignoring their obvious lack of 'free will'. The latifundia/minifundia structure began to break down: MINIFUNDIA LOST THE CAPACITY TO ABSORB POPULATION INCREASES, WHILE LATIFUNDIA, THANKS TO MECHANIZATION, NEEDED LESS RAW LABOUR POWER. The Southern style of urbanization, based NOT ON THE LURE OF GROWING INDUSTRIAL EMPLOYMENT BUT ON THE COLLAPSE OF RURAL LIFE, was set in motion. After the Western powers failed to crush the Russian revolution militarily, the CHALLENGE WAS AGAIN TO 'SAVE LIBERALISM FROM ITSELF': there had to be an ALTERNATIVE TO REVOLUTION AND COLLECTIVIZATION. RIGHT-WING social solutions were right-wing because they NEITHER ATTACKED THE OWNERS OF THE LATIFUNDIA NOR TRIED TO FORCE FOREIGN ENTERPRISES TO SUBSIDIZE THE POOR AGRICULTURAL SECTOR; they offered road building, irrigation and the extension of power into the countryside, plus RESETTLEMENT (the Dutch 'Ethical Policy', Mussolini's African imperial scheme). The PROGRESSIVE version adopted the same strategies with less inclination to privatize the agents of transformation (Roosevelt's TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY), but the main concern was LAND REFORM in the broadest sense: converting large holdings into viable small ones, consolidating minifundia into cooperatives, abolishing SHARECROPPING, replacing rural moneylenders with cooperative or state credit, and COOPERATIVE MARKETING BOARDS as regulated MONOPSONISTS. Here the reformers were MUCH LESS SUCCESSFUL than elsewhere and, with exceptions such as Mexico, the DEPRESSION sank most of the schemes. INTERNATIONAL ECONOMIC LAW: the same mode of thought led to the REJECTION OF THE 'GOLD STANDARD / FREE TRADE / PRIVATE INTERNATIONAL LAW' REGIME. Beginning in the 1920s but exploding AFTER 1929, this is the period of 'AUTARKY', better described as NATIONAL STRATEGIES based on bilateral agreements and then on the formation of BLOCS — first imperial, then ideological. IMPORT SUBSTITUTION INDUSTRIALIZATION (ISI) began in Latin America; one of the 19th-century intellectual origins of the social was the German NATIONALÖKONOMIE school's advocacy of ISI policies. Latin American economists, who had been passionate fans of free trade as long as it favoured rapid development, reconsidered their position and modernized nationalökonomie; ISI became the development strategy of right-wing nationalist regimes in ARGENTINA AND BRAZIL: TARIFFS, MANIPULATED EXCHANGE RATES, CURRENCY CONTROLS, IMPORT LICENCES AND SUBSIDIZED CREDIT, plus the development of a STATE-OWNED OR HEAVILY REGULATED SECTOR.

terms.def: Import substitution industrialization — tariffs, manipulated exchange rates, currency controls, import licences and subsidized credit in favour of local firms, plus a state sector.

cards.q: In what sense were social rights 'legal' and in what sense not?
cards.a: They were LEGAL, EVEN CONSTITUTIONAL — FIRST IN MEXICO IN 1917 — BUT NOT JUSTICIABLE AS TO THE LEVEL OF BENEFITS PROVIDED, although justiciable as entitlements once established by statute in the administrative regime of the country concerned. They were understood as a 'THIRD GENERATION' after private law and political rights.

cards.q: Which two political configurations could introduce the social state?
cards.a: Either an ELECTORAL MAJORITY (the New Deal in the USA, the Front Populaire in France, the corporatist social democracy of Austria) OR AN AUTHORITARIAN ELITE (Germany, Argentina). Both had to accept REDISTRIBUTION to the weaker classes AND PATERNALIST CONTROL over their spending decisions.

cards.q: Why did latifundia and minifundia begin to break down, and what kind of urbanization followed?
cards.a: MINIFUNDIA LOST THE CAPACITY TO ABSORB POPULATION INCREASES (falling mortality with the same birth rate), WHILE LATIFUNDIA, THANKS TO MECHANIZATION, NEEDED LESS RAW LABOUR POWER. The result was the Southern style of urbanization based NOT ON THE LURE OF INDUSTRIAL EMPLOYMENT BUT ON THE COLLAPSE OF RURAL LIFE.

cards.q: What is ISI and where does it come from?
cards.a: IMPORT SUBSTITUTION INDUSTRIALIZATION: tariffs, manipulated exchange rates, currency controls, import licences and subsidized credit in favour of local firms, plus a state-owned or heavily regulated sector. Its intellectual origin is the German NATIONALÖKONOMIE school; it became the strategy of right-wing nationalist regimes in ARGENTINA AND BRAZIL.

slides.title: The post-war triumphs of the social, and Keynes
slides.text: The Depression and the war at once stimulated and stifled institutional innovation, but THE SHEER INTENSITY OF THE CATASTROPHE, together with the defeat of fascism and the containment of communism, made possible A WHOLE COLLECTION OF INSTITUTIONAL TRIUMPHS FOR THE PROGRESSIVE VERSION OF THE SOCIAL: (1) the creation of a NATIONALLY AND INTERNATIONALLY REGULATED MARKET ECONOMY for the capitalist core countries; (2) the GLOBALIZATION OF THE BRETTON WOODS SYSTEM; (3) the globalization — first from the victors to the vanquished and then from the first to the third world — OF THE PROGRESSIVE SOCIAL REFORM PROGRAMME of restructuring entitlements as the basis of a highly regulated mixed capitalist economy pursuing a strategy of SOCIAL PEACE THROUGH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT. And Kennedy's formulation, worth knowing: IF JHERING IS THE UNDISPUTED GRANDFATHER OF THE SOCIAL, JOHN MAYNARD KEYNES WAS PERHAPS ITS GENIUS — although he thought the 'save it from itself' strategy SHOULD OPERATE AT THE STATE AND INTERNATIONAL LEVEL AND LEAVE THE CLT STRUCTURE OF PRIVATE PROPERTY AND FREE CONTRACT UNTOUCHED. The IMF was founded on the idea of the INTERDEPENDENCE of financial and monetary markets, where the danger is RUNS ON NATIONAL CURRENCIES triggering chain-reaction downward spirals; the way to stop them was to 'NIP THEM IN THE BUD' FROM A POSITION OUTSIDE AND ABOVE ANY PARTICULAR NATIONAL STRATEGIC ACTOR. There was a SHARED 'PUBLIC INTEREST' in such intervention, so long as it was carefully limited so as NOT TO INTRUDE ON NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY IN MONETARY AND FISCAL POLICY. Macroeconomic monetary and fiscal policy were, meanwhile, PRECISELY WHAT THE CLT MODEL (FREE TRADE, THE GOLD STANDARD, PRIVATE INTERNATIONAL LAW) HAD BEEN DESIGNED TO ELIMINATE. KEYNES'S CONTRIBUTION: to show that fiscal and monetary policy could rationally operate 'COUNTERCYCLICALLY', COUNTERACTING BY STRATEGIC ACTION FROM THE CENTRE THE INDIVIDUALIST CAPITALIST LOGIC OF BOOM FOLLOWED BY BUST, and thereby benefiting everyone. But fiscal and monetary policy also meant DEFICIT SPENDING IN PERIODS OF CONTRACTION, and thus OPENED THE POSSIBILITY OF FINANCING THE WHOLE PROGRAMME OF THE SOCIAL REFORMERS PRECISELY IN THE PERIODS WHEN THEY HAD HISTORICALLY BEEN FORCED TO CLOSE UP SHOP.

cards.q: Which three institutional triumphs of the progressive social came after the war?
cards.a: 1) The creation of a NATIONALLY AND INTERNATIONALLY REGULATED MARKET ECONOMY for the core countries. 2) The GLOBALIZATION OF THE BRETTON WOODS SYSTEM. 3) The globalization of the PROGRESSIVE REFORM PROGRAMME — restructuring entitlements as the basis of a regulated mixed economy pursuing SOCIAL PEACE THROUGH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT.

cards.q: What was Keynes's relation to the social and what was his double contribution?
cards.a: If JHERING IS THE GRANDFATHER OF THE SOCIAL, KEYNES WAS ITS GENIUS — although he wanted to operate at the state and international level and LEAVE THE CLT STRUCTURE OF PRIVATE PROPERTY AND FREE CONTRACT UNTOUCHED. He showed that policy could work 'COUNTERCYCLICALLY' against the logic of boom and bust — and at the same time DEFICIT SPENDING opened the possibility of FINANCING THE SOCIAL REFORMERS' PROGRAMME PRECISELY IN THE PERIODS WHEN THEY HAD HISTORICALLY BEEN FORCED TO CLOSE UP SHOP.

slides.title: Decolonization, Bandung and the last analytic feat of the social
slides.text: BETWEEN 1945 AND THE MID-1960s decolonization brought into being a world order of independent 'national' states. The old and new national elites of the periphery were freed from direct, that is jurisdictional, control; almost as important, WITHOUT THE GOLD STANDARD THEY WERE FREE TO MANIPULATE THEIR CURRENCIES AND NATIONAL BUDGETS FOR WHATEVER SOVEREIGN PURPOSES. They soon discovered, however, that they NEEDED ACCESS TO WORLD CAPITAL MARKETS — and that meant joining the Bretton Woods system: EITHER PLAY THE GAME ON EXACTLY THE TERMS DESIGNED, THAT IS WITHIN THE ALREADY EXISTING STRUCTURE OF LEGAL RULES, OR STARVE IN THE DARK. THE THIRD WORLD OR BANDUNG RESPONSE (NEHRU, NASSER, SUKARNO) and the school of progressive public international law DEPLOYED THE SOCIAL CRITIQUE OF THE INDIVIDUALISM OF CLASSICAL PRIVATE LAW AGAINST THE POST-WAR, SUPPOSEDLY REFORMED, POSTCOLONIAL REGIME OF INTERNATIONAL LAW. The argument is elegant and worth memorizing verbatim: THE FORMAL EMANCIPATION AND GRANTING OF RIGHTS TO UNFREE LABOUR IN EUROPE MERELY SHIFTED THE MECHANISM OF EXPLOITATION FROM THE TRANSPARENCY OF FEUDALISM TO THE MYSTIFICATION OF CAPITALISM; THE FORMAL GRANTING OF NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE TO COLONIZED NATIONS SIMILARLY SHIFTED THE TRANSPARENCY OF IMPERIAL RULE INTO THE MYSTIFICATION OF NEOCOLONIALISM. In place of the exploitative wage contract, the modern international order operated through the UNEQUAL EXCHANGE OF THIRD WORLD PRIMARY PRODUCTS FOR FIRST WORLD INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS. And Kennedy's own assessment: 'THIS SEEMS TO ME THE LAST STRICTLY ANALYTIC FEAT OF SOCIAL CONSCIOUSNESS.'

cards.q: How did the Bandung argument against the post-war international order run?
cards.a: By analogy: THE FORMAL EMANCIPATION OF UNFREE LABOUR IN EUROPE MERELY SHIFTED EXPLOITATION FROM THE TRANSPARENCY OF FEUDALISM TO THE MYSTIFICATION OF CAPITALISM — and FORMAL NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE SIMILARLY SHIFTED THE TRANSPARENCY OF IMPERIAL RULE INTO THE MYSTIFICATION OF NEOCOLONIALISM. In place of the wage contract there is the UNEQUAL EXCHANGE OF PRIMARY FOR INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS. Kennedy calls this THE LAST STRICTLY ANALYTIC FEAT OF SOCIAL CONSCIOUSNESS.

cards.q: What choice did the new states face after decolonization?
cards.a: They were freed from jurisdictional control and, without the gold standard, could freely manipulate their currencies and budgets — but they needed ACCESS TO WORLD CAPITAL MARKETS. So: EITHER PLAY THE GAME ON EXACTLY THE TERMS DESIGNED, WITHIN THE ALREADY EXISTING STRUCTURE OF LEGAL RULES, OR STARVE IN THE DARK.

slides.title: Two phases of the globalization of the regulated mixed economy
slides.text: THE FIRST PHASE: immediately after the war the Allies FORCIBLY AND SYSTEMATICALLY CONVERTED THE JAPANESE, GERMAN AND ITALIAN SYSTEMS FROM THE FASCIST TO THE PROGRESSIVE VERSION OF THE SOCIAL, and imposed a similar conversion on the South Korean and Taiwanese systems AS THE PRICE OF PROTECTION against the Chinese communists. In Japan, South Korea and Taiwan LAND REFORM was an important component, along with at least paper rights for trade unions and at least paper regulation of the financial system; Germany and Italy were incorporated into the SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC / CHRISTIAN DEMOCRATIC MODEL. THE SECOND PHASE: the extension of the ISI strategy across Latin America and into the newly independent Third World — first into the very large economies (INDIA, EGYPT, TURKEY, IRAN, INDONESIA) and AFTER 1960 into the very small economies of the newly independent African states. ISI, heavily dependent on public law and government intervention, was strongly supported by UN AGENCIES, THE WORLD BANK AND USAID, and was the initial economic strategy of Taiwan and South Korea (and Singapore) before they gradually shifted to export-led growth. And Kennedy's characterization, which sums up the political ambiguity of the whole thing: IT WAS A PRODUCT OF KEYNESIAN LIBERALISM AS MUCH AS OF DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISM, AS STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AS IT WAS ANTI-LAISSEZ-FAIRE. ISI typically involved THE EXPLOITATION OF THE COUNTRYSIDE, supposedly in the interest of creating industrial capital in the cities, through the tariffs and marketing boards the social people had pioneered in the 1930s. EXCEPT FOR SOUTH KOREA AND TAIWAN AT THE MOMENT OF MAXIMUM COMMUNIST THREAT AND MAXIMUM LIBERAL INFLUENCE IN WASHINGTON, VERY FEW PROGRESSIVE REGIMES (EGYPT, BOLIVIA) ACTUALLY BROKE UP THE LARGE ESTATES. And Kennedy's sharp conclusion: THE REFUSAL TO JOIN THE SOVIET BLOC WAS MORE THAN A MATTER OF DIPLOMACY — THE REFORMING THIRD WORLD ELITES ADOPTED THE ECONOMIC INSTITUTIONS OF THE SOCIAL CURRENT RATHER THAN THE COMMUNIST ONES. AND THEY AVOIDED SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC REVOLUTION WITHOUT HAVING TO GIVE UP THEIR OWN ENJOYMENTS.

cards.q: What did the Allies do with the defeated countries and with South Korea and Taiwan?
cards.a: They FORCIBLY AND SYSTEMATICALLY CONVERTED the Japanese, German and Italian systems FROM THE FASCIST TO THE PROGRESSIVE VERSION OF THE SOCIAL — and imposed a similar conversion on South Korea and Taiwan AS THE PRICE OF PROTECTION against the Chinese communists. LAND REFORM, union rights and financial regulation were components; Germany and Italy went into the SOCIAL / CHRISTIAN DEMOCRATIC MODEL.

cards.q: What was the political character of ISI and what ultimately characterizes it?
cards.a: IT WAS A PRODUCT OF KEYNESIAN LIBERALISM AS MUCH AS OF DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISM, AS STRONGLY ANTI-COMMUNIST AS IT WAS ANTI-LAISSEZ-FAIRE. It typically involved THE EXPLOITATION OF THE COUNTRYSIDE through tariffs and marketing boards — and except for South Korea and Taiwan, very few regimes (Egypt, Bolivia) ACTUALLY BROKE UP THE LARGE ESTATES.

cards.q: Why did the Third World elites not join the Soviet bloc?
cards.a: It was MORE THAN A MATTER OF DIPLOMACY: THEY ADOPTED THE ECONOMIC INSTITUTIONS OF THE SOCIAL CURRENT RATHER THAN THE COMMUNIST ONES — AND THEREBY AVOIDED SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC REVOLUTION WITHOUT HAVING TO GIVE UP THEIR OWN ENJOYMENTS.

slides.title: The critique of the social: cumulative and contradictory
slides.text: It is hard to overstate the global transformation of positive law brought about by the reformers of the social current. But again: NO PARTICULAR SOCIAL REGIME WAS GLOBALIZED, the degree of socialization differed from country to country and, within each country, from decade to decade. Taking 1968 as a rough marker of the demise of the social as the dominant legal consciousness, we would have to say that IT TRIUMPHED INSTITUTIONALLY, BUT IN AS MANY FORMS AS THERE WERE SOVEREIGNS — THAT IS, AS PAROLE, NOT AS STRUCTURE. The critique of the social was a CUMULATIVE PHENOMENON, beginning IN THE 1930s with the second wave of legislative reform (the first had occurred in the decade before the First World War) and developing alongside the gradual adoption of social law. THERE WAS ONLY A BRIEF PERIOD, LOOSELY DESIGNATED 'THE FIFTIES', DURING WHICH THE SOCIAL HAD NO STRONG OPPONENT (CLT HAD BEEN DISCREDITED AND MARXISM WAS DISINTEGRATING IN THE WEST). The critiques that reached critical mass by 1968 were THEORETICALLY, POLITICALLY AND PROGRAMMATICALLY CONTRADICTORY. The social they targeted was an INSTITUTIONALIZED, THOROUGHLY ENTRENCHED STATUS QUO administered at the level of legal doctrine by a cadre of lawyers WHO HAD KNOWN NOTHING BUT THE SOCIAL SUPERIMPOSED ON CLT. They were ADMINISTRATORS, NOT REFORMERS OR INTELLECTUALS, and most of them ignored the critiques they noticed. Kennedy adds acidly: THAT SITUATION HAS NOT CHANGED MUCH TO THIS DAY, EXCEPT THAT THE SOCIAL PEOPLE NOW LAMENT THE MYSTERIOUS 'RESURGENCE' OF CLT AFTER 1980. By contrast, THE BRILLIANT EARLY SOCIAL PEOPLE AIMED A RELATIVELY UNIFIED CRITIQUE — 'INDIVIDUALISM PLUS THE ABUSE OF DEDUCTION' — AT CLT AT THE MOMENT WHEN A RELATIVELY UNIFIED SOCIAL PROGRAMME WAS EMERGING TRANSNATIONALLY AS A POWERFUL THREAT TO THE ESTABLISHED ORDER.

cards.q: How did the social 'triumph' and what does that mean?
cards.a: IT TRIUMPHED INSTITUTIONALLY, BUT IN AS MANY FORMS AS THERE WERE SOVEREIGNS — THAT IS, AS PAROLE, NOT AS STRUCTURE. There was no single end point to which national regimes of positive law converged.

cards.q: Why was the critique of the social weaker than the earlier critique of CLT?
cards.a: Because it was THEORETICALLY, POLITICALLY AND PROGRAMMATICALLY CONTRADICTORY and was aimed at an INSTITUTIONALIZED STATUS QUO administered by a cadre of ADMINISTRATORS, NOT REFORMERS. By contrast the early social people aimed a RELATIVELY UNIFIED critique ('individualism plus the abuse of deduction') at the moment when a relatively unified social programme was emerging as a POWERFUL THREAT TO THE ESTABLISHED ORDER.

cards.q: When did the social have no strong opponent?
cards.a: ONLY IN THE BRIEF PERIOD LOOSELY DESIGNATED 'THE FIFTIES' — CLT had been discredited and MARXISM WAS DISINTEGRATING IN THE WEST. Otherwise the critique was a CUMULATIVE PHENOMENON from the 1930s on, developing alongside the adoption of social law.

slides.title: Two critiques from the 1930s: is-to-ought and the link with totalitarianism
slides.text: THE FIRST: THE CRITIQUE OF THE IS-TO-OUGHT MOVE, that is, of deriving reform legislation from the science of society. Two main sources: MAX WEBER and the LOGICAL POSITIVISTS. Weber influenced European lawyers such as HANS KELSEN — for whom sociological jurisprudence was merely a VEILED VEHICLE FOR 'NATURAL LAW TENDENCIES' — and Americans such as KARL LLEWELLYN. AFTER THE WAR, American pragmatism in its philosophical version turned decisively against its founders' 'is-to-ought' version, leaving behind rather Deweyan lawyers, for example the LEGAL PROCESS SCHOOL. The is-to-ought critique involved a move parallel to the critique of the abuse of deduction in CLT: THE SOCIAL PEOPLE COULD MAINTAIN THE ILLUSION THAT THEY WERE DERIVING LEGAL RULES FROM SOCIAL NEEDS, FUNCTIONS OR PURPOSES ONLY BY IGNORING THE PERVASIVE PHENOMENON OF CONFLICT BETWEEN DESIRABLE GOALS — thereby producing something aptly named 'SOCIAL CONCEPTUALISM'. And this sentence is the key to understanding the third globalization: THIS FIRST CRITIQUE IS THE INTELLECTUAL ANCESTOR OF MODERN POLICY ANALYSIS. THE SECOND, LIBERAL AND NEOLIBERAL CRITIQUE: THE ASSOCIATION OF THE SOCIAL WITH FASCISM AND COMMUNISM (HAYEK, THE ROAD TO SERFDOM, 1944). There are many paradoxes here: there was a strong MARXIST critique of the social as a mere palliative, and at the same time a quite striking INCORPORATION OF THE SOCIAL INTO THOSE PARTS OF SOVIET LEGAL IDEOLOGY THAT TODAY LOOK LEAST 'COMMUNIST'. The social people, meanwhile, included the dominant ANTI-COMMUNIST AND ANTI-FASCIST intellectual currents of the interwar period, with the agenda of SAVING LIBERALISM FROM ITSELF. And in the post-war period, as the social jurists gradually faded from view, THE LIBERALS WHO HAD TREATED THEM AS CORRUPT RESTED THEIR CASE AGAINST COMMUNISM ON THE POST-WAR SUCCESS OF THE REFORM INSTITUTIONS OF THE 1930s, PUSHED THROUGH AFTER THE WAR BY THE SOCIAL PEOPLE OVER LIBERAL OBJECTIONS.

terms.def: The illusion that legal rules are derived from social needs — sustainable only by ignoring the pervasive conflict between desirable goals.

cards.q: How did the is-to-ought critique run and what is it the ancestor of?
cards.a: The social people could maintain the illusion that they derived rules from social needs ONLY BY IGNORING THE PERVASIVE CONFLICT BETWEEN DESIRABLE GOALS — thereby producing 'SOCIAL CONCEPTUALISM'. Sources: MAX WEBER and the LOGICAL POSITIVISTS (Kelsen: sociological jurisprudence is merely a veiled vehicle for 'natural law tendencies'). THIS CRITIQUE IS THE INTELLECTUAL ANCESTOR OF MODERN POLICY ANALYSIS.

cards.q: What is the paradox of the liberal critique of the social as fascist and communist?
cards.a: That the social people themselves included the DOMINANT ANTI-COMMUNIST AND ANTI-FASCIST currents with the agenda of SAVING LIBERALISM FROM ITSELF. And after the war THE LIBERALS WHO HAD TREATED THEM AS CORRUPT RESTED THEIR CASE AGAINST COMMUNISM PRECISELY ON THE SUCCESS OF THE REFORM INSTITUTIONS OF THE 1930s, pushed through by the social people over liberal objections. (Hayek, The Road to Serfdom, 1944.)

slides.title: The critiques of the 1960s and 70s: antiformalism under fire
slides.text: The dominant rhetoric of the critique was CIVIL LIBERTARIAN and made possible a DE FACTO ALLIANCE OF LEFT AND RIGHT, rather like the one that had joined the social democratic and the fascist versions of the social. THE CRITIQUE TARGETED THE PROCEDURAL DIMENSION OF THE SOCIAL REFORM PROGRAMME, THAT IS, ITS ANTIFORMALISM. In family law, criminal law, labour law, public housing, the law of civil commitment and the law of prisons, mental hospitals and juvenile homes, the social programme involved creating new institutions DELIBERATELY DESIGNED TO EMPOWER ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICIALS ACTING ON THE BASIS OF EXPERTISE, IN THE PUBLIC INTEREST AND IN THE INTEREST OF CLIENTS LACKING FULL CAPACITY. The civil libertarians attacked those institutions as DENYING INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS and their administrators as ARBITRARY AND IMPLICITLY AUTHORITARIAN MANIPULATORS OF EMPTY GENERAL STANDARDS AND EMPTY EXPERTISE. At one level this was a demand for PROCEDURAL RIGHTS — hearings applying rationally intelligible decisional criteria, with judicial review, before the administrators did something to their charges. BUT BEHIND THAT DEMAND LAY A SEISMIC CULTURAL AND POLITICAL SHIFT, occurring more or less simultaneously across the developed West. THE POLITICAL CONTEXT: the discrediting of the socially oriented leadership of the VIETNAM WAR ('the best and the brightest'), with perhaps 2,000,000 dead; the discrediting of the Soviet alternative by the PRAGUE SPRING and AFGHANISTAN; the gradual discrediting of Third World revolutionary national liberation ideology in CHINA (the Great Leap Forward, the Red Guards), GHANA and ALGERIA; the discrediting of Western radicalism by the WEATHER UNDERGROUND, the BLACK PANTHERS, the RED BRIGADES and the BAADER/MEINHOF GROUP, of pan-Arabism in the 1967 Arab-Israeli war and by the assassination of the Israeli Olympic athletes in Munich. The massacre of 500,000 communists and sympathizers by the army and Islamists in INDONESIA, when the US-backed Suharto replaced Sukarno amid the economic chaos of a failed ISI strategy, and of 1,000,000 ordinary people by POL POT's communist regime in CAMBODIA after the USA had 'destabilized' the country; the descent of one African state after another from import substitution into KLEPTOCRACY — and Kennedy's essential qualification: NONE OF THIS WAS THE 'FAULT' OF THE SOCIAL, NOT AT ALL. THE 'GOOD' SOCIAL PEOPLE HATED ALL OF IT. AND YET… THE WHOLE 'REGIME' WAS DISCREDITED, EXPERTISE WAS DISCREDITED, AND SO ON AD INFINITUM.

cards.q: What did the critique of the social in the 1960s and 70s target, and what alliance did it make possible?
cards.a: THE PROCEDURAL DIMENSION of the reform programme, THAT IS, ITS ANTIFORMALISM: institutions empowering ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICIALS on the basis of EXPERTISE, in the PUBLIC INTEREST and in the interest of CLIENTS LACKING FULL CAPACITY. The dominant rhetoric was CIVIL LIBERTARIAN and made possible a DE FACTO ALLIANCE OF LEFT AND RIGHT.

cards.q: What is Kennedy's position on the catastrophes that discredited the social?
cards.a: That NONE OF IT WAS THE 'FAULT' OF THE SOCIAL, NOT AT ALL — THE 'GOOD' SOCIAL PEOPLE HATED ALL OF IT. AND YET the WHOLE 'REGIME' WAS DISCREDITED AND EXPERTISE WAS DISCREDITED. (Vietnam, the Prague Spring, Afghanistan, the Great Leap Forward, 500,000 dead in Indonesia, 1,000,000 in Cambodia, the African kleptocracies.)

slides.title: The rebellion of the left and the two-track attack of the right
slides.text: THE NON-COMMUNIST LEFT REBELLION against the social was as much cultural and intellectual as political. Behind the civil libertarians were writers such as KEN KESEY (ONE FLEW OVER THE CUCKOO'S NEST, 1962), JEAN GENET (1963) and BETTY FRIEDAN (THE FEMININE MYSTIQUE, 1964), who REIMAGINED THE SUPPOSEDLY BENEFICENT SOCIAL INSTITUTIONS AS FORMS OF HELL analogous to the hells of the public sphere of the time, and POSTSTRUCTURALIST THEORISTS OF THE SOCIAL AS 'DISCIPLINE' IN THE WAKE OF FOUCAULT. According to DONZELOT, the New Left around the world, when it was not Marxist-Leninist, was a UTOPIAN REBELLION AGAINST THE SOCIAL — AND IT FAILED BECAUSE THE MASSES IT APPEALED TO HAD BEEN TURNED BY THE SOCIAL INTO THE STRONGEST SUPPORTS OF THE STATUS QUO. And Kennedy's point, not to be forgotten: WHAT IS REMARKABLE ABOUT THE END OF THE SOCIAL ON THE LEFT IS THAT WHAT REPLACED IT BORE NO RELATION TO THAT REBELLIOUS OR UTOPIAN-ANARCHIST STRAND. IT WAS RATHER A REVIVAL OF FAITH IN RIGHTS — HUMAN THIS TIME RATHER THAN INDIVIDUAL OR SOCIAL — IN LEGAL FORMALITY RATHER THAN THE STANDARDS OF THE SOCIAL, AND IN THE JUDICIARY AS A NON-POLITICAL, NON-MURDEROUS DEFENCE AGAINST THE MILITARY-INDUSTRIAL-SOCIAL-ADMINISTRATIVE STATE THE SOCIAL SEEMED TO HAVE BECOME. ON THE RIGHT there was a TWO-TRACK ATTACK: (1) SOCIAL CONSERVATIVES such as CHRISTOPHER LASCH attacked the social institutions for UNDERMINING, THROUGH SOCIAL ENGINEERING AND BUREAUCRATIC SERVICE DELIVERY, THE VERY SOCIAL BONDS THEY CLAIMED TO PRESERVE. (2) FROM 1968 ON, the slowly emerging NEOLIBERAL charge that the social programme has PERVERSE ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CONSEQUENCES: it is bad for economic growth, it requires the middle classes to subsidize the lower, and it HARMS THE PEOPLE IT MEANS TO HELP by forcing them to buy social protections worth less to them than their cost in increased prices — summed up in the slogan 'NON-WAIVABLE TENANT PROTECTIONS FORCE LANDLORDS TO RAISE THE RENT AND EVICT GRANDMOTHER' (POSNER, 1972). The period around 1968 involved something less distinct and definitive than the discrediting of CLT by the events from the outbreak of the First World War to the Depression and the rise of fascism and communism. But Kennedy, in NEO-HEGELIAN ORGANICIST TERMS, sees it as THE MOMENT WHEN THE COCOON BROKE UP AROUND THE LEGAL CONSCIOUSNESS WE CALL CONTEMPORARY.

cards.q: What is remarkable about what replaced the social on the left?
cards.a: That it BORE NO RELATION TO THE REBELLIOUS OR UTOPIAN-ANARCHIST STRAND that had brought the social down. It was a REVIVAL OF FAITH IN RIGHTS — HUMAN this time rather than individual or social — IN LEGAL FORMALITY RATHER THAN THE STANDARDS OF THE SOCIAL AND IN THE JUDICIARY AS A NON-POLITICAL, NON-MURDEROUS DEFENCE against the military-industrial-social-administrative state.

cards.q: What was the two-track attack of the right on the social?
cards.a: 1) SOCIAL CONSERVATIVES (Christopher Lasch): the social institutions UNDERMINE, THROUGH SOCIAL ENGINEERING AND BUREAUCRATIC SERVICES, THE VERY SOCIAL BONDS THEY CLAIM TO PRESERVE. 2) The NEOLIBERAL charge of perverse consequences: bad for growth, the middle classes subsidize the lower, and it HARMS THE PEOPLE IT MEANS TO HELP ('non-waivable tenant protections force landlords to raise the rent and evict grandmother', Posner 1972).

cards.q: Why does Donzelot claim the New Left failed?
cards.a: Because it was a UTOPIAN REBELLION AGAINST THE SOCIAL and it failed BECAUSE THE MASSES IT APPEALED TO HAD BEEN TURNED BY THE SOCIAL INTO THE STRONGEST SUPPORTS OF THE STATUS QUO.

slides.title: The third globalization: unsynthesized coexistence
slides.text: Kennedy warns that these ideas are 'quite preliminary as yet'. Although it is easy to see the first and second globalizations as THESIS AND ANTITHESIS, THE THIRD CANNOT BE SEEN — AND DOES NOT SEE ITSELF — AS A SYNTHESIS. It resembles the first two in being based on a BRUTAL CRITIQUE OF ITS PREDECESSOR, here the social. BUT IT DIFFERS FROM BOTH CLT AND THE SOCIAL IN THAT THERE IS NO RECOGNIZABLE GRAND INTEGRATING CONCEPT IN IT — PARALLEL TO WILL THEORY OR TO THE NOTION OF ADJUSTMENT TO INTERDEPENDENCE — THAT WOULD MEDIATE BETWEEN NORMATIVE PROJECTS AND THE SUBSYSTEMS OF POSITIVE LAW. Kennedy therefore describes the structure of consciousness globalized after 1945 as the UNSYNTHESIZED COEXISTENCE OF TRANSFORMED ELEMENTS OF CLT WITH TRANSFORMED ELEMENTS OF THE SOCIAL. (And he adds a joke: the fact that he does not himself 'totalize' may mean only that dusk has not yet fallen on 'modernity' and his owl of Minerva could not take flight.) THE KEY TRANSFORMED ELEMENT OF CLT IS THINKING IN THE MODE OF DEDUCTION WITHIN A SYSTEM OF POSITIVE LAW PRESUMED COHERENT, THAT IS, 'NEOFORMALISM'. Neoformalism has proliferated wildly, but it is also largely CONFINED TO PUBLIC LAW — INTERNATIONAL, CONSTITUTIONAL AND CRIMINAL (NOT ADMINISTRATIVE) — AND TO FAMILY LAW. It can be right-wing or left-wing. By contrast, THE LEGAL SCIENCE OF CLT WAS A SCIENCE OF THE LAW OF OBLIGATIONS. THE KEY TRANSFORMED ELEMENT OF THE SOCIAL IS POLICY ANALYSIS, BUT BASED ON 'CONFLICTING CONSIDERATIONS' (also called BALANCING or PROPORTIONALITY). IT PRODUCES RULES THAT ARE AD HOC COMPROMISES, NOT SOCIAL RULES DICTATED BY PARTICULAR SOCIAL PURPOSES IN COHERENTLY ADAPTIVE NEW REGIMES. This mode too can be right-wing or left-wing and is present everywhere — so it sometimes, surprisingly, COEXISTS WITH NEOFORMALISM.

terms.def: The transformed element of CLT: thinking in the mode of deduction within a system of positive law presumed coherent; mainly in public and family law.

cards.q: Why is the third globalization not a synthesis of the first two?
cards.a: Because there is NO RECOGNIZABLE GRAND INTEGRATING CONCEPT in it parallel to WILL THEORY or to the notion of ADJUSTMENT TO INTERDEPENDENCE that would mediate between normative projects and the subsystems of positive law. It is an UNSYNTHESIZED COEXISTENCE OF TRANSFORMED ELEMENTS OF CLT WITH TRANSFORMED ELEMENTS OF THE SOCIAL.

cards.q: Which two elements does the third globalization take over — and from where?
cards.a: From CLT: NEOFORMALISM — thinking in the mode of DEDUCTION within a system presumed coherent, mainly in PUBLIC (international, constitutional, criminal, NOT administrative) AND FAMILY LAW. From the SOCIAL: POLICY ANALYSIS based on 'CONFLICTING CONSIDERATIONS' (balancing, proportionality), which produces AD HOC COMPROMISES. Both modes can be right-wing or left-wing.

slides.title: Residual CLT and residual social — and reversed valences
slides.text: Between 1850 and 1950 the plurality of schools of legal philosophy DID NOT produce a diversity of modes of legal imagination, argument and law-making: UNTIL ABOUT 1900 EVERYONE ENDED UP AT SOME VERSION OF WILL THEORY, AND AFTER 1900 AT SOME VERSION OF EITHER WILL THEORY OR THE SOCIAL. TODAY the positive legal regimes in every field all over the world are those that emerged FROM THE CONFRONTATION, AT THE LEVEL OF LEGISLATION OR CASE LAW, BETWEEN CLT AND THE SOCIAL, UNDERSTOOD AS PROJECTS OF LAW REFORM RATHER THAN AS LEGAL CONSCIOUSNESS. Everywhere there is a SUBSTRATUM of positively enacted classical contract law and a SUPERSTRUCTURE of positively enacted social labour law; everywhere there are administrative agencies for a host of socially problematic areas; and everywhere there is free-market law (itself more or less internally 'socialized') governing below, between and among the regulatory regimes. WHAT IS NOT THERE IS A NEW WAY OF CONCEIVING THE LEGAL ORGANIZATION OF SOCIETY, a new conception at the same level of abstraction as CLT or the social. Institutional innovation goes on constantly (structural adjustment, the European Commission, securitization), BUT EACH NEW PIECE OF POSITIVE LAW PRESENTS ITSELF AS PAROLE, DISSOLVABLE INTO AN ENLARGED LEGAL LANGUE THAT NOW INCLUDES, AS INTERCHANGEABLE ELEMENTS, ALL THE INNOVATIVE CONCEPTS OF THE SOCIAL ALONGSIDE THOSE OF CLT — NOT IN PLACE OF THEM. On that terrain it is still possible to ARGUE LIKE A CLASSIC: to start from the premise that law is or ought to be the coherent elaboration of a coherent idea of individual freedom insofar as it is compatible with the like freedom of others. IN MARKET LAW that mode of argument today identifies one as a NEOLIBERAL, LIBERTARIAN OR FREE-MARKET CONSERVATIVE — CLT IN ITS PURE OR REACTIONARY FORM IS TODAY A RIGHT-WING PROJECT RATHER THAN A LEGAL CONSCIOUSNESS. It is also still possible to argue as though there were an evident LOGIC OF SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT: whereas before the Second World War that would have identified one as a FASCIST just as likely as a PROGRESSIVE, 'RESIDUAL SOCIAL' IS TODAY, IN MARKET LAW, ALMOST ALWAYS A PROGRESSIVE POSITION. Like CLT, the social in market law has lost its POLITICAL INDETERMINACY and ended up on the left rather than the right. In these residual, politicized forms CLT and the social ARE NOT SO MUCH DISCREDITED AS OBSOLETE, 'OLD HAT', TIRED WAYS OF PROCEEDING, SPORADICALLY POWERFUL, MORE OFTEN MERELY RITUAL. AND THESE VALENCES ARE REVERSED IN THE LAW OF SEX AND THE FAMILY: THERE, CLT IS LEFT-WING OR LIBERAL FEMINIST OR LIBERTARIAN, WITH EQUAL RIGHTS STILL A PROGRAMME FOR TRANSFORMING RELATIONS BETWEEN MEN AND WOMEN AND FOR THE LIBERATION OF 'SEXUAL MINORITIES'. THE SOCIAL, BY CONTRAST, IS IN THE LAW OF SEX AND THE FAMILY CONSERVATIVE, TRADITIONALIST OR AUTHORITARIAN, THE EXACT OPPOSITE OF ITS VALENCE IN MARKET LAW — the pre-war traditionalist element survives here as ASIAN, ISLAMIC, OFFICIAL CATHOLIC OR FUNDAMENTALIST CHRISTIAN VALUES set against the 'decadence' of Western sexual and familial rules and mores.

cards.q: What is missing today, although institutional innovation goes on constantly?
cards.a: A NEW WAY OF CONCEIVING THE LEGAL ORGANIZATION OF SOCIETY, a new conception AT THE SAME LEVEL OF ABSTRACTION AS CLT OR THE SOCIAL. Each new piece of positive law presents itself as PAROLE, dissolvable into an ENLARGED LANGUE that now includes the concepts of the social ALONGSIDE those of CLT — NOT IN PLACE OF THEM.

cards.q: What political valences do CLT and the social have in market law today?
cards.a: IN MARKET LAW the classical argument identifies one as a NEOLIBERAL, LIBERTARIAN OR FREE-MARKET CONSERVATIVE — CLT is today a RIGHT-WING PROJECT rather than a legal consciousness. 'RESIDUAL SOCIAL' is by contrast ALMOST ALWAYS A PROGRESSIVE POSITION, although before the Second World War it would have identified a fascist just as likely as a progressive. Both have lost their POLITICAL INDETERMINACY.

cards.q: How are the valences of CLT and the social reversed in the law of sex and the family?
cards.a: There CLT is LEFT-WING, LIBERAL FEMINIST OR LIBERTARIAN (equal rights as a programme for transforming relations between men and women and liberating 'sexual minorities'). THE SOCIAL is by contrast CONSERVATIVE, TRADITIONALIST OR AUTHORITARIAN — the pre-war element survives as ASIAN, ISLAMIC, CATHOLIC OR FUNDAMENTALIST CHRISTIAN VALUES.

slides.title: Policy analysis against neoformalism — and the judge as hero
slides.text: POLICY ANALYSIS, the first of the great innovations of post-war legal thought, is concerned with THE ONGOING ADMINISTRATION OF PRE-EXISTING LEGAL REGIMES UNDERSTOOD AS COMPROMISES BETWEEN 'INDIVIDUALIST' (CLT) AND SOCIAL DESIRABLE GOALS. PUBLIC LAW NEOFORMALISM, the second great innovation, is a DISRUPTIVE, NOT A MANAGERIAL MODE, applied sometimes to institutions embodying the social, sometimes to institutions embodying CLT. IT APPEALS — BEHIND THE SETTLEMENT BETWEEN CLT AND THE SOCIAL REPRESENTED BY THE INSTITUTION IN QUESTION — TO SUPPOSEDLY TRANSCENDENT BUT AT THE SAME TIME POSITIVELY ENACTED VALUES IN CONSTITUTIONS OR TREATIES, AGAINST THE STATUS QUO. The contrast is beautifully put: IN PLACE OF THE UNSELFCONSCIOUS CONFIDENCE IN REASON AND SCIENCE OF CLT AND THE MILITANT SELF-ASSERTION OF THE SOCIAL, POLICY ANALYSIS HAS FOR FIFTY YEARS BEEN THE VEHICLE OF A MODEST, CRAFTSMANLY DEDICATION TO DOING LEGAL WORK WITH WHATEVER MATERIAL IS LEFT OVER FROM THE GRANDIOSE PROJECTS OF THE PAST. Its practitioners are proudest when their conclusions are DEFENSIBLE AS NON-POLITICAL, BECAUSE THEY PLEASE AND DISPLEASE LEFT AND RIGHT WITH NO OBVIOUS PATTERN. PUBLIC LAW NEOFORMALISM, by contrast, REBELS IN THE NAME OF THE 'ABSOLUTE' OF THOSE OUTRAGED IN A PARTICULAR CONTEXT AND IS UNREFLECTIVE IN A WAY DIAMETRICALLY OPPOSED TO POLICY ANALYSIS. Kennedy's examples of such arguments: that the CLOSED SHOP VIOLATES THE GUARANTEE OF FREEDOM OF ASSOCIATION IN THE MEXICAN CONSTITUTION; that the FAILURE TO CRIMINALIZE CLITORIDECTOMY VIOLATES CEDAW; that AFFIRMATIVE ACTION IN AMERICAN UNIVERSITY ADMISSIONS VIOLATES EQUAL PROTECTION; that ANY JUDGE IN ANY COUNTRY MAY AUTHORIZE THE DETENTION OF PINOCHET for human rights violations contrary to international law. THEY ALL PRESUPPOSE EITHER A MYSTICAL UNION OF NATURAL AND POSITIVE LAW OR A MODE OF DEDUCTION FROM ABSTRACTIONS THAT THE EARLY SOCIAL THEORISTS EFFECTIVELY DEMOLISHED. And the hero: IN PLACE OF THE CLT PROFESSOR AND THE LEGISLATOR/ADMINISTRATOR OF THE SOCIAL, THE HEROIC FIGURE OF THE THIRD GLOBALIZATION IS UNMISTAKABLY THE JUDGE, APPLYING EITHER POLICY ANALYSIS OR NEOFORMALISM AS BEST HE CAN TO DISPUTES FRAMED BY GOVERNMENTAL AND NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATIONS CLAIMING TO REPRESENT CIVIL SOCIETY.

cards.q: Compare policy analysis and public law neoformalism.
cards.a: POLICY ANALYSIS is MANAGERIAL: it deals with the ONGOING ADMINISTRATION of pre-existing regimes understood as COMPROMISES between individualist and social goals; it is MODEST, CRAFTSMANLY and proud that its conclusions are NON-POLITICAL. NEOFORMALISM is DISRUPTIVE: it REBELS IN THE NAME OF THE 'ABSOLUTE' against the status quo, appealing to supposedly transcendent but positively enacted values in constitutions or treaties — and it is UNREFLECTIVE in a diametrically opposed way.

cards.q: Who is the heroic figure of the third globalization?
cards.a: UNMISTAKABLY THE JUDGE, applying either POLICY ANALYSIS or NEOFORMALISM as best he can TO DISPUTES FRAMED BY GOVERNMENTAL AND NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATIONS CLAIMING TO REPRESENT CIVIL SOCIETY. (In place of the law professor in CLT and the legislator/administrator in the social.)

cards.q: Which arguments exemplify public law neoformalism and what do they presuppose?
cards.a: That the CLOSED SHOP violates freedom of association in the Mexican constitution; that the FAILURE TO CRIMINALIZE CLITORIDECTOMY violates CEDAW; that AFFIRMATIVE ACTION violates equal protection; that ANY JUDGE MAY AUTHORIZE THE DETENTION OF PINOCHET. They all presuppose EITHER A MYSTICAL UNION OF NATURAL AND POSITIVE LAW OR A MODE OF DEDUCTION FROM ABSTRACTIONS THAT THE EARLY SOCIAL THEORISTS EFFECTIVELY DEMOLISHED.

slides.title: Lidská práva a identita: co nahradilo práva a třídy
slides.text: LIDSKÁ PRÁVA HRAJÍ V SOUČASNÉM PRÁVNÍM VĚDOMÍ TUTÉŽ ROLI, JAKOU HRÁLA 'SOUKROMÁ PRÁVA' V CLT A 'SOCIÁLNÍ PRÁVA' V SOCIÁLNÍM. IDENTITA HRAJE ROLI, KTEROU HRÁL JEDNOTLIVEC V CLT A TŘÍDY A NÁRODNÍ MENŠINY V SOCIÁLNÍM. Současný ideál je právní režim, který je PLURALISTICKÝ — ale ne ve smyslu CLT, který koordinoval ATOMIZOVANÉ JEDNOTLIVCE UNIVERZÁLNĚ PLATNÝMI ABSTRAKTNÍMI PRAVIDLY, ani ve smyslu sociálního, zaujatého HLEDÁNÍM A PODPOROU 'PLATNÉHO' 'ŽIVÉHO' PRÁVA SUBKOMUNIT jako cesty k distributivní spravedlnosti, NÝBRŽ VE SMYSLU NÁLEŽITÉHO UZNÁVÁNÍ A ZVLÁDÁNÍ 'ROZDÍLU'. Individuální a korporátní vlastnická a smluvní práva milovaná CLT byla OMEZENOU TŘÍDOU, sevřenou UCTÍVÁNÍM SUVERÉNNÍ MOCI na jedné straně a OSTRÝM ROZLIŠENÍM MEZI PRÁVNÍ A MORÁLNÍ POVINNOSTÍ na druhé. JSOU PŘEDKEM, ALE NE MODELEM současných lidských práv, ani nejsou ústřední v jejich pantheonu. Kolektivní sociální práva (jídlo, bydlení, práce, zdraví) milovaná sociálním jsou víceméně vydobytá v pozitivním právu, ale stejně jako vlastnická práva CLT jsou POJMOVĚ NA OKRAJI současného právního vědomí v jeho nadnárodní formě. Současné právní vědomí je KONCOVÝM BODEM DLOUHÉHO PROCESU, V NĚMŽ OBECNÝ POJEM PRÁVA VYSTOUPAL ZE SVÉHO HISTORICKÉHO MINIMA VE 30. LETECH (vrchol pravicové i levicové verze sociálního), ABY SE STAL UNIVERZÁLNÍ PRÁVNÍ LINGVISTICKOU JEDNOTKOU. LIDSKÁ PRÁVA JSOU 'HYPOSTATIZACÍ' TOHOTO TRENDU, FUNGUJÍCÍ JAKO UNIVERZÁLIE, ZÁROVEŇ PŘIROZENÉ A POZITIVNÍ, ZPŮSOBEM PODIVNĚ ANALOGICKÝM FUNGOVÁNÍ PRÁVA, VŮLE A ZAVINĚNÍ V SOUKROMÉM PRÁVU CLT. Fungují také někdy jako PRAVIDLA (dokonce absolutní) a někdy jako POUHÉ POLITIKY, potenciálně relevantní prakticky v každém právním sporu i tam, kde není tvrzeno porušení uzákoněné ústavy, charty či smlouvy.

cards.q: Jaké role v současném právním vědomí odpovídají rolím v CLT a sociálním?
cards.a: LIDSKÁ PRÁVA hrají roli 'SOUKROMÝCH PRÁV' v CLT a 'SOCIÁLNÍCH PRÁV' v sociálním. IDENTITA hraje roli, kterou hrál JEDNOTLIVEC v CLT a TŘÍDY A NÁRODNÍ MENŠINY v sociálním.

cards.q: V jakém smyslu je současný ideál 'pluralistický'?
cards.a: NE ve smyslu CLT, který koordinoval ATOMIZOVANÉ JEDNOTLIVCE UNIVERZÁLNĚ PLATNÝMI ABSTRAKTNÍMI PRAVIDLY; ani ve smyslu sociálního, zaujatého HLEDÁNÍM 'ŽIVÉHO' PRÁVA SUBKOMUNIT jako cesty k distributivní spravedlnosti. NÝBRŽ VE SMYSLU NÁLEŽITÉHO UZNÁVÁNÍ A ZVLÁDÁNÍ 'ROZDÍLU'.

cards.q: Jsou vlastnická práva CLT a sociální práva modelem dnešních lidských práv?
cards.a: NE. Vlastnická a smluvní práva CLT byla OMEZENOU TŘÍDOU sevřenou uctíváním suverénní moci a ostrým rozlišením právní/morální povinnosti — JSOU PŘEDKEM, ALE NE MODELEM a nejsou ústřední v pantheonu. Kolektivní sociální práva (jídlo, bydlení, práce, zdraví) jsou v pozitivním právu vydobytá, ale POJMOVĚ NA OKRAJI současného nadnárodního vědomí.

slides.title: Identita jako lingua franca — i v právu trhu
slides.text: Současné právní vědomí organizuje nositele nároků podle jejich PLURÁLNÍCH, KŘÍŽÍCÍCH SE 'IDENTIT'. Identita představuje zároveň ROZŠÍŘENÍ I ÚPLNOU TRANSFORMACI kategorií — sociální třída a národní menšina — jimiž sociální juristé rozložili savignyovský 'LID'. Současné identity se kříží v tom smyslu, že KAŽDÝ Z NÁS JICH MÁ MNOHO. V současném globálním právním vědomí je pojem identity POTOMKEM SOCIÁLNÍ STAROSTI NE O DOMINANTNÍ, NÝBRŽ O PODŘÍZENÉ ČI DISKRIMINOVANÉ ČI PRONÁSLEDOVANÉ IDENTITY; identita je typicky ZÁKLADEM NÁROKU PROTI 'VĚTŠINĚ' ČI 'DOMINANTNÍ KULTUŘE'. Myšlení identitou STŘÍDÁ ESENCIALIZACI toho, co znamená mít určitý rys, který jeho nositele odlišuje — aby se rozvinuly a legitimizovaly právní nároky — A SNAHU TY NÁROKY SMÍŘIT, KDYŽ SE STŘETNOU. Přímočaré nacionalistické nároky a nároky založené na třídním či národnostně menšinovém útlaku nejsou dnes o nic méně časté než v meziválečném období; JEN UŽ NEJSOU PARADIGMATICKÉ. DISKURS IDENTITY A PRÁV se na první pohled zdá být veřejnoprávním a rodinněprávním jevem, ALE JE TO VE SKUTEČNOSTI SKUTEČNÁ LINGUA FRANCA, STEJNĚ POUŽITELNÁ V PRÁVU TRHU. Na straně typických beneficientů — toho, čemu sociální juristé říkají 'SLABÉ STRANY' (ženy, diskriminované menšiny, dnes i 'chudí' chápaní jako identita, ne jako třída) — FORMÁLNÍ TRŽNÍ PRÁVO UŽ IDENTITU NEIGNORUJE: někteří veřejní i soukromí tržní aktéři, ale ne jiní, mají zakázáno diskriminovat některé identity, ale ne jiné, což znamená, že MOHOU BÝT PŘINUCENI OBCHODOVAT PROTI SVÉ VŮLI, za určitou ekonomickou cenu, nebo nuceni jednat za PŘÍZNIVĚJŠÍCH PODMÍNEK, NEŽ BY NOSITELÉ IDENTITY ZÍSKALI NA 'SVOBODNÉM' TRHU. Dějiny diskriminačního zacházení s identitou zakládají SLOŽITÉ EKONOMICKÉ NÁROKY proti soukromým tržním aktérům či vlastníkům v přítomnosti.

cards.q: Čeho je pojem identity potomkem a proti komu se nárok obvykle vede?
cards.a: POTOMKEM SOCIÁLNÍ STAROSTI NE O DOMINANTNÍ, NÝBRŽ O PODŘÍZENÉ, DISKRIMINOVANÉ ČI PRONÁSLEDOVANÉ IDENTITY. Identita je typicky ZÁKLADEM NÁROKU PROTI 'VĚTŠINĚ' ČI 'DOMINANTNÍ KULTUŘE' — a myšlení identitou STŘÍDÁ ESENCIALIZACI rysu (aby se nároky legitimizovaly) A SNAHU JE SMÍŘIT, KDYŽ SE STŘETNOU.

cards.q: Jak diskurs identity funguje v právu trhu?
cards.a: Je to SKUTEČNÁ LINGUA FRANCA, ne jen veřejnoprávní jev. FORMÁLNÍ TRŽNÍ PRÁVO UŽ IDENTITU NEIGNORUJE: někteří aktéři mají zakázáno diskriminovat některé identity, takže MOHOU BÝT PŘINUCENI OBCHODOVAT PROTI SVÉ VŮLI za ekonomickou cenu nebo jednat ZA PŘÍZNIVĚJŠÍCH PODMÍNEK, NEŽ BY NOSITELÉ IDENTITY ZÍSKALI NA 'SVOBODNÉM' TRHU.

slides.title: Silné strany se přeoblékají za menšinu
slides.text: Na straně 'SILNÝCH STRAN' — zaměstnavatelů, věřitelů, prodejců hmotných i nehmotných komodit — probíhá trvalá snaha, EMBLEMATICKÁ PRO SOUČASNÉ PRÁVNÍ VĚDOMÍ, PŘEKONFIGUROVAT VLASTNICKÁ A SMLUVNÍ PRÁVA JAKO PARALELNÍ MENŠINOVÉ IDENTITĚ A JEJÍM PRÁVŮM. VÝCHODOEVROPŠTÍ DISIDENTŠTÍ TEORETICI PRÁV, pro něž byl sociální implikován ne-li v komunismu, tak aspoň v jeho tolerování v letech do roku 1989, ZAHRNULI SOUKROMÉ VLASTNICTVÍ DO SVÉHO KATALOGU TOHO, CO BYLO ZA KOMUNISMU UPŘENO. Nejzazší realizací toho trendu je AMARTYA SEN A JEHO ZAHRNUTÍ 'PRÁVA VĚNOVAT SE PODNIKATELSKÉ ČINNOSTI' DO KATALOGU OCHRANY LIDSKÉHO POTENCIÁLU, což je asi nejlépe chápat jako SOUČÁST TŘETISVĚTOVÉ REAKCE PROTI SOCIÁLNÍMU, jak se projevil v neúspěšných ISI režimech 60. a 70. let. MEZINÁRODNÍ PODNIKATELSKÁ KOMUNITA se postupně přizpůsobila vzestupu rétoriky práv identity tím, že PŘEMĚNILA VLASTNICTVÍ MAJETKU V MENŠINOVOU IDENTITU A VLÁDNÍ REGULACI V ANALOG DISKRIMINACE ZÁKONODÁRNÝMI VĚTŠINAMI. Skrze WTO například nadnárodní firmy požadují ochranu práv duševního vlastnictví proti praktikám třetisvětových zemí, které odmítají uznávat patenty a ochranné známky nebo zabraňovat 'PIRÁTSTVÍ' — a Kennedy neodolá poznámce: HEZKY PARALELNĚ K POŽADAVKU MEZINÁRODNÍHO KAPITÁLU, ABY IMPERIALISTICKÉ STÁTY POTLAČILY HMATATELNÉ PIRÁTSTVÍ VE STŘEDOMOŘÍ NA POČÁTKU 19. STOLETÍ KOLONIZACÍ SEVERNÍ AFRIKY. NADĚJE SOCIÁLNÍHO, ŽE INSTITUCIONÁLNÍ MECHANISMUS ZALOŽENÝ NA UZNÁNÍ ORGANIZOVANÝCH SKUPIN (jako v korporativismu) MŮŽE SPRÁVNĚ DOSÁHNOUT SMÍRU, ZMIZELA. Stejně jako byl komplex lid/národ CLT rozerván zaměřením na sociální třídy a národní menšiny, TAK SE ŘÁD ZALOŽENÝ NA TŘÍDÁCH A NÁRODNÍCH MENŠINÁCH ROZTŘÍŠTIL, KDYŽ SE POJEM IDENTITY ZAČAL KŘÍŽIT. Konečný výsledek: pojem identity a soubor právních pojmů a technik založených na ideji práva, jimiž identity vstupují do práva (diskriminace, akomodace atd.), JSOU OBECNÉ — ALE POSKYTUJÍ JEN LANGUE, POUŽITOU K VÝROBĚ NEKONEČNÉ ROZMANITOSTI KONKRÉTNÍCH ARGUMENTŮ A REŽIMŮ POZITIVNÍHO PRÁVA JAKO PAROLE. Každý národní právní systém si sám volí, které identity uzná a které stigmatizuje, ALE ARGUMENTY PRO A PROTI UZNÁNÍ JSOU SI TÉMĚŘ IDENTICKÉ NAPŘÍČ ČASEM I PROSTOREM. Když je identita uznána, bude to typicky současnou směsicí VYSOCE FORMÁLNÍCH NOREM ROVNOSTI A NEDISKRIMINACE s vysoce vyjednaným, AD HOC souborem norem o TOLERANCI NEBO AKOMODACI PRAKTIK DEFINUJÍCÍCH IDENTITU ('sodomie', závoj) a o AFIRMATIVNÍ AKCI ČI REPARACÍCH — jinými slovy VEŘEJNOPRÁVNÍ NEOFORMALISMUS KOMBINOVANÝ S KONFLIKTUJÍCÍMI ÚVAHAMI. ŘEŠENÍ BUDE TOLIK, KOLIK JE ZÁKONODÁRNÝCH AUTORIT.

cards.q: Jak se silné strany přizpůsobily rétorice práv identity?
cards.a: PŘEMĚNILY VLASTNICTVÍ MAJETKU V MENŠINOVOU IDENTITU A VLÁDNÍ REGULACI V ANALOG DISKRIMINACE ZÁKONODÁRNÝMI VĚTŠINAMI. Východoevropští disidenti zahrnuli SOUKROMÉ VLASTNICTVÍ do katalogu upřeného za komunismu; AMARTYA SEN zahrnul 'PRÁVO VĚNOVAT SE PODNIKATELSKÉ ČINNOSTI' do ochrany lidského potenciálu; skrze WTO firmy požadují ochranu duševního vlastnictví proti 'PIRÁTSTVÍ'.

cards.q: Proč zmizela naděje sociálního na korporativistický smír?
cards.a: Protože stejně jako byl komplex LID/NÁROD v CLT rozerván zaměřením na sociální třídy a národní menšiny, TAK SE ŘÁD ZALOŽENÝ NA TŘÍDÁCH A NÁRODNÍCH MENŠINÁCH ROZTŘÍŠTIL, KDYŽ SE POJEM IDENTITY ZAČAL KŘÍŽIT — každý z nás má identit mnoho.

cards.q: Jak typicky vypadá právní uznání identity?
cards.a: Směsicí VYSOCE FORMÁLNÍCH NOREM ROVNOSTI A NEDISKRIMINACE s vysoce vyjednaným, AD HOC souborem norem o TOLERANCI ČI AKOMODACI PRAKTIK definujících identitu ('sodomie', závoj) a o AFIRMATIVNÍ AKCI ČI REPARACÍCH — tedy VEŘEJNOPRÁVNÍ NEOFORMALISMUS KOMBINOVANÝ S KONFLIKTUJÍCÍMI ÚVAHAMI. ŘEŠENÍ BUDE TOLIK, KOLIK JE ZÁKONODÁRNÝCH AUTORIT.

slides.title: Americká genealogie třetí globalizace
slides.text: Každý rys třetí globalizace má ROZPOZNATELNOU AMERICKOU GENEALOGII ve smyslu, že postupujeme-li od přítomnosti zpět, brzy narazíme na americké vývoje, které ty globální aspoň předznamenávají. VEŘEJNOPRÁVNÍ NEOFORMALISMUS silně připomíná PRAKTIKY AMERICKÝCH SOUDŮ KONCE 19. STOLETÍ, KTERÉ VZALY KONSTRUKCI SOUKROMÉHO PRÁVA CLT A APLIKOVALY JI NA AMERICKOU ÚSTAVU. Po druhé světové válce převzali tutéž praxi skrze WARRENŮV SOUD LIBERÁLNÍ OBČANŠTÍ LIBERTARIÁNI, KTEŘÍ DŘÍVE KONZERVATIVNÍ VEŘEJNOPRÁVNÍ NEOFORMALISMUS OSTŘE KRITIZOVALI. POLICY ANALYSIS A BALANCING byly POSTREALISTICKÝM americkým vývojem a zastánci balancingu už NA POČÁTKU 50. LET debatovali s veřejnoprávními neoformalisty. KOMPLEX IDENTITA/PRÁVA se v USA předznamenává POVÁLEČNOU ALIANCÍ ELITNÍCH WASPŮ, ŽIDŮ A ČERNOCHŮ PŘI KONSTRUKCI KATEGORIE ETNICITY, SPOJUJÍCÍ ZLA HOLOCAUSTU SE ZLY RASISMU V USA JAKO NEZÁKONNOU DISKRIMINACI. AMERICKÝ FEMINISMUS DRUHÉ VLNY je odpovědný za ABSTRAKCI A GENERALIZACI té kategorie tím, že ji PROMĚNIL V 'IDENTITU'. A od DE TOCQUEVILLA je známo, že Američané inklinují k JURISTOKRACII. HLAVNÍ MÍSTA rozvoje současného právního vědomí mají silné americké napojení: (1) ÚSTAVNÍ SOUDY se soudním přezkumem, často ohledně rozdělení moci ve federálních systémech i práv proti státu, které vznikly po celém světě od roku 1945; (2) vzestup NADNÁRODNÍCH JURISDIKCÍ v mnoha kontextech od EU přes WTO po Mezinárodní tribunál pro válečné zločiny; (3) v praxi práva rozvoj VELKÉ MEZINÁRODNÍ ADVOKÁTNÍ KANCELÁŘE AMERICKÉHO STYLU a rovněž globalizovaného NEZISKOVÉHO NGO SEKTORU, chápajícího se jako 'MEZINÁRODNÍ SPOLEČENSTVÍ' či 'MEZINÁRODNÍ OBČANSKÁ SPOLEČNOST'.

cards.q: Jakou americkou genealogii má veřejnoprávní neoformalismus?
cards.a: Silně připomíná PRAKTIKY AMERICKÝCH SOUDŮ KONCE 19. STOLETÍ, KTERÉ VZALY KONSTRUKCI SOUKROMÉHO PRÁVA CLT A APLIKOVALY JI NA ÚSTAVU. Po válce převzali tutéž praxi skrze WARRENŮV SOUD LIBERÁLNÍ OBČANŠTÍ LIBERTARIÁNI — právě ti, kdo dřívější konzervativní neoformalismus ostře kritizovali.

cards.q: Odkud se v USA vzal komplex identita/práva?
cards.a: Z POVÁLEČNÉ ALIANCE ELITNÍCH WASPŮ, ŽIDŮ A ČERNOCHŮ PŘI KONSTRUKCI KATEGORIE ETNICITY, která SPOJILA ZLA HOLOCAUSTU SE ZLY RASISMU V USA JAKO NEZÁKONNOU DISKRIMINACI. AMERICKÝ FEMINISMUS DRUHÉ VLNY tu kategorii ABSTRAHOVAL A ZOBECNIL TÍM, ŽE JI PROMĚNIL V 'IDENTITU'.

cards.q: Jaká jsou tři hlavní místa rozvoje současného právního vědomí?
cards.a: 1) ÚSTAVNÍ SOUDY se soudním přezkumem, vznikající po celém světě od roku 1945. 2) NADNÁRODNÍ JURISDIKCE od EU přes WTO po Mezinárodní tribunál pro válečné zločiny. 3) VELKÁ MEZINÁRODNÍ ADVOKÁTNÍ KANCELÁŘ amerického stylu a globalizovaný NEZISKOVÝ NGO SEKTOR chápající se jako 'mezinárodní občanská společnost'.

slides.title: Je to 'opravdu' amerikanizace? Vnucení, vyjednávání, prestiž
slides.text: Vliv USA je zjevný a stejně jako u šíření CLT lze rozlišit VÍCE ČI MÉNĚ NÁSILNÉ VNUCENÍ od VNUCENÍ SKRZE PŘEVAHU VE VYJEDNÁVÁNÍ a obojí od PRESTIŽE. U ústavních soudů začíná vývoj VÍTĚZSTVÍM USA NAD NĚMECKEM, ITÁLIÍ A JAPONSKEM VE DRUHÉ SVĚTOVÉ VÁLCE a pokračuje VÍTĚZSTVÍM VE STUDENÉ VÁLCE. Pak je tu proces, v němž USAID A MEZINÁRODNÍ FINANČNÍ INSTITUCE VYJEDNÁVAJÍ S TŘETISVĚTOVÝMI REŽIMY ZOUFALE POTŘEBUJÍCÍMI FINANČNÍ ZÁCHRANU A VNUCUJÍ REFORMU PRÁVNÍHO STÁTU JAKO SOUČÁST STRUKTURÁLNÍHO PŘIZPŮSOBENÍ.
